items.title: Cisco Stock Looks Expensive Until You Price The Year It Already Guided
items.summary: Cisco Systems (CSCO) trades near $106 a share, about 24.6 times the $4.33 of non-GAAP earnings per share it reported for fiscal 2026. That is the same basis Cisco uses for its guidance and analysts use for their forecasts. For a networking supplier with $63.33 billion of revenue behind it, that is rich. And it ignores the two years analysts have already forecast.

items.title: Cisco (CSCO) Unveils Quantum Networking Push With New Distributed Systems Collaboration
items.summary: Cisco Systems (NasdaqGS:CSCO) announced a collaboration with quantum technology firm Infleqtion to advance distributed quantum networking architectures. The partners plan to work on quantum memory to optical transduction and networked quantum devices for long distance connectivity. Cisco highlighted a prototype Universal Quantum Switch as part of its push to connect, operate, and scale quantum systems.
